attachment: Existing M5 dataset.jsonl -> model_candidate.inputs[].features.history; no parallel datastore or runtime integration in this PR
compatibility: Existing M6 HISTORY_FEATURE_CONTRACT_NOT_VALIDATED remains unchanged and enforced
evidence_quarantine: Original raw history lines may contain odds/prizes. Retain as evidence, never pass raw text, market columns or target outcomes as fundamental features.

field_statuses.EXTRACTED: Usable typed value supported by specified evidence; not identity/PIT/model approval
field_statuses.NOT_REPORTED: Explicitly absent/not reported; never false or zero
field_statuses.UNKNOWN_CODE: Raw code retained; affected semantic value prohibited
field_statuses.AMBIGUOUS: Multiple defensible interpretations; affected value prohibited

historical_date.normalization: Exact source date; no century guessing
historical_date.source_and_identity_requirements: Original PDF date token and uniquely attributed horse block
historical_date.cutoff: Historical event precedes target analysis cutoff; actual feature availability must be strictly before cutoff, all timestamps aware; same-day date-only history excluded
historical_date.pit_verification: Documented publication or conservative direct observation upper bound for this exact source fact and verified horse/race identity before cutoff; retrieval of a retrospective result is not proof of earlier feature availability

historical_track.normalization: Preserve raw code; resolve to physical track only with country/date/provider evidence
historical_track.source_and_identity_requirements: Code alone is not historical race identity; B/J are country-ambiguous
historical_track.cutoff: Historical event precedes target analysis cutoff; actual feature availability must be strictly before cutoff, all timestamps aware; same-day date-only history excluded
historical_track.pit_verification: Documented publication or conservative direct observation upper bound for this exact source fact and verified horse/race identity before cutoff; retrieval of a retrospective result is not proof of earlier feature availability

historical_race_number.normalization: Keep physical race number separate from V86/V4 legs
historical_race_number.source_and_identity_requirements: Calendar + exact track/date/race; composite sections require whole-field reconciliation
historical_race_number.cutoff: Historical event precedes target analysis cutoff; actual feature availability must be strictly before cutoff, all timestamps aware; same-day date-only history excluded
historical_race_number.pit_verification: Documented publication or conservative direct observation upper bound for this exact source fact and verified horse/race identity before cutoff; retrieval of a retrospective result is not proof of earlier feature availability

distance_m.normalization: Read actual historical starter distance, not target-race or base distance
distance_m.source_and_identity_requirements: Unambiguous historical distance cell; official corroboration separately recorded
distance_m.cutoff: Historical event precedes target analysis cutoff; actual feature availability must be strictly before cutoff, all timestamps aware; same-day date-only history excluded
distance_m.pit_verification: Documented publication or conservative direct observation upper bound for this exact source fact and verified horse/race identity before cutoff; retrieval of a retrospective result is not proof of earlier feature availability

start_method.normalization: AUTO from documented explicit source marker; do not infer VOLT from missing a; official values remain a separate layer
start_method.source_and_identity_requirements: Versioned codebook or explicit historical race metadata; never copy target start method
start_method.cutoff: Historical event precedes target analysis cutoff; actual feature availability must be strictly before cutoff, all timestamps aware; same-day date-only history excluded
start_method.pit_verification: Documented publication or conservative direct observation upper bound for this exact source fact and verified horse/race identity before cutoff; retrieval of a retrospective result is not proof of earlier feature availability

placing.datatype: tagged category and optional positive integer
placing.normalization: PLACED requires positive integer; UNPLACED, DQ, DNF, QUALIFIER and UNKNOWN remain distinct; zero is never numeric rank or DQ
placing.source_and_identity_requirements: Versioned country/provider result semantics; qualification excluded from ordinary-start aggregates
placing.cutoff: Historical event precedes target analysis cutoff; actual feature availability must be strictly before cutoff, all timestamps aware; same-day date-only history excluded
placing.pit_verification: Documented publication or conservative direct observation upper bound for this exact source fact and verified horse/race identity before cutoff; retrieval of a retrospective result is not proof of earlier feature availability

km_time.normalization: Explicit decimal time 11,1 -> 71.1; codes frd8a/5g/ug/it/br are not numeric times; retain raw code
km_time.source_and_identity_requirements: Readable numeric time cell, documented unit and normalization; no filling from external result into PDF truth
km_time.cutoff: Historical event precedes target analysis cutoff; actual feature availability must be strictly before cutoff, all timestamps aware; same-day date-only history excluded
km_time.pit_verification: Documented publication or conservative direct observation upper bound for this exact source fact and verified horse/race identity before cutoff; retrieval of a retrospective result is not proof of earlier feature availability

gallop_flag.normalization: Only explicit source/codebook evidence; no false from absence of g
gallop_flag.cutoff: Historical event precedes target analysis cutoff; actual feature availability must be strictly before cutoff, all timestamps aware; same-day date-only history excluded
gallop_flag.pit_verification: Documented publication or conservative direct observation upper bound for this exact source fact and verified horse/race identity before cutoff; retrieval of a retrospective result is not proof of earlier feature availability

disqualification_flag.normalization: Do not equate zero, unplaced or gallop with DQ; unknown d/dg mappings remain unknown without documented meaning
disqualification_flag.source_and_identity_requirements: Explicit disqualification evidence or documented provider code semantics
disqualification_flag.cutoff: Historical event precedes target analysis cutoff; actual feature availability must be strictly before cutoff, all timestamps aware; same-day date-only history excluded
disqualification_flag.pit_verification: Documented publication or conservative direct observation upper bound for this exact source fact and verified horse/race identity before cutoff; retrieval of a retrospective result is not proof of earlier feature availability

qualification_flag.normalization: Separate qualification/approved trial from ordinary competitive starts; k is contextual, never a placing
qualification_flag.source_and_identity_requirements: Printed qualifier marker and approval token in correct columns; preserve gdk separately
qualification_flag.cutoff: Historical event precedes target analysis cutoff; actual feature availability must be strictly before cutoff, all timestamps aware; same-day date-only history excluded
qualification_flag.pit_verification: Documented publication or conservative direct observation upper bound for this exact source fact and verified horse/race identity before cutoff; retrieval of a retrospective result is not proof of earlier feature availability

track_identity.normalization: Only unambiguous NO/SE code register; collisions B/F/J/S never resolved from target country
track_identity.identity_limit: Provider track ID and historical horse/race identity still require independent evidence

temporal_rule: Reject historical event >= target date. This is event-date screening, not PIT verification. PDF date and retrospective identity do not prove historical availability.
market_rule: No raw evidence, odds/prize tokens or target result in feature values. Original raw line retained only in quarantined research evidence.
future_m5_adapter: No automatic attachment to model_candidate in this delivery. A later approved adapter must whitelist typed EXTRACTED values plus identity/PIT proof, retain labels separately and preserve HISTORY_FEATURE_CONTRACT_NOT_VALIDATED until explicitly approved.
